note: Development scenarios, visible during design. Not an independent heldout set.

scenarios.what: An ordinary question and unknown data; identity stays natural without invented facts.

turns.en: How many new customers did we have yesterday?

turns.es: Gracias por aclarar lo que sabes y no sabes.
turns.en: Thanks for clarifying what you do and do not know.

scenarios.what: Responds to criticism without collapsing into generic apologies.

turns.es: Tu respuesta anterior fue demasiado larga. Necesito algo directo.
turns.en: Your last response was too long. I need something direct.

turns.es: Así está mejor. ¿Qué fue lo más importante?
turns.en: That is better. What was the main point?

scenarios.what: Keeps consistent style in routine conversation.

turns.en: What music would you put on while working?

turns.es: Hoy tuve una reunión muy aburrida.
turns.en: I had a really boring meeting today.
Anyway, I have to go. See you!
